scope: Semantic comparison of all 99 canonical rule statements/verification with full current runtime entrypoint/governance/create/audit/explain and all mapping verification obligations. Source handbook chapters 00-12 and playbooks considered. Companion review record, not canonical rule-traceability compliance result.
limitations: No native host or complete agent workflow trial in this subreview.
Historical 77 MB catalogs/receipts were not reviewed semantically per record.
Archive preservation and runtime/helper correctness delegated to parent/other reviewers.
Procedural coverage does not certify any target.
